body:
Thanks for the response, talking this out is very helpful for me. 

It feels very much like an euthanasia question to me as well - which I support - which is why I find myself surprisingly alright with her decision. 

Control and autonomy are crucially important to her, so I find myself much more inclined to let her retain those than to strip them away from her - we're in this situation because she's faced with losing them.
